description: BELGIUM. Computes the costs of buying an existing home in Brussels-Capital, Wallonia or Flanders: the Region's registration duty (12.5% / 12% or the sole-home reduced rate and abatements), the notary fees from the legal tariff plus VAT, the estimated other costs, and optionally the mortgage deed. Same figures as the calculator on payotte.com/belgium/purchase-costs (FR: /belgique/frais-achat, NL: /belgie/aankoopkosten).

flemish_core_city.description: Flanders only: the home is in a core city (centrumstad) or the Flemish Periphery (Vlaamse Rand). Default false.

loan_amount.description: Optional: mortgage amount in euros, to add the cost of the mortgage deed.

municipality.description: Optional: a municipality Payotte covers (e.g. "Liège", "Gent", "Ixelles"), used to find the Region when region is omitted.

region.description: Region of the home. Registration duties are regional. May be omitted if municipality is given.

sole_home.description: Sole and own home (you will live there and own no other home). Default true. False = normal rates.

name: purchase_costs_be
title: Belgian home purchase costs: registration duty, notary, other costs
